Example National Node

This node is part of the EOSC Federation and provides compute, storage and data analysis services to researchers and public sector organisations in the host country. Access to authenticated services is provided through the EOSC AAI federated identity infrastructure, so any researcher holding an eligible institutional or community identity can sign in without a separate account.

All services listed in our catalogue are governed by the acceptable use policy of the node and by the rules of participation of the federation. Support is available during working hours from the national helpdesk, and incidents are handled according to the published service level description.
